vocabulary.name: thresholdUsage
vocabulary.description: Transaction amount as a percentage of the merchant's fraud threshold (100 = exactly at the threshold)

vocabulary.name: unusualActivity
vocabulary.description: The transaction shows unusual activity for this merchant

vocabulary.name: merchantKycVerified
vocabulary.description: The merchant has passed KYC (know your customer) checks

vocabulary.name: held
vocabulary.description: Held for review by a fraud analyst

vocabulary.name: autoApproved
vocabulary.description: Approved automatically by the system, without manual review

vocabulary.name: analystApproved
vocabulary.description: Approved by a fraud analyst after review

vocabulary.name: approved
vocabulary.description: Approved, either automatically or by a fraud analyst

vocabulary.name: rejected
vocabulary.description: Rejected and will not be processed

vocabulary.name: settled
vocabulary.description: Settled: the money has been paid out to the merchant

vocabulary.name: ledgerSynced
vocabulary.description: Synced to the core banking ledger

requirements.text: A transaction above 90% of the merchant's fraud threshold is held for review.
A transaction with unusual activity is held for review.
A held transaction cannot be approved automatically.
A transaction from a KYC-verified merchant that is not held is approved automatically.
A transaction from a merchant without verified KYC is rejected.
A rejected transaction cannot be approved.
An automatically approved transaction counts as approved.
A transaction approved by a fraud analyst counts as approved.
Fraud analysts only approve transactions that were held for review.
A transaction can only be settled once it is approved.
Only settled transactions are synced to the core banking ledger.
A held transaction can be approved by a fraud analyst.
A transaction with unusual activity can come from a KYC-verified merchant.
A transaction above the merchant's fraud threshold can still be settled after review.

demos.label: Contradiction
demos.text: Transactions above 95% of the fraud threshold are rejected automatically.

demos.label: Dead rule
demos.text: Automatically approved transactions with unusual activity are escalated to Risk & Compliance.

demos.label: Redundant
demos.text: A transaction with unusual activity cannot be approved automatically.

demos.label: Side effect
demos.text: Transactions with unusual activity are always rejected.

demos.label: Fits
demos.text: Transactions above 75% of the fraud threshold are flagged for monitoring.

newTerms.name: flaggedForMonitoring
newTerms.description: Flagged for monitoring, without blocking the transaction
